# uptimekuma_notification_smspartner (Resource)

SMS Partner notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smspartner" "example" {
  name         = "SMS Partner Alerts"
  api_key      = "YOUR_SMSPARTNER_API_KEY"
  phone_number = "+33612345678"
  sender_name  = "UptimeKuma"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_smspartner" "production" {
  name         = "SMS Partner Production Alerts"
  api_key      = "your_api_key_here"
  phone_number = "+33698765432"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = true
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smspartner" "write_only" {
  name = "SMS Partner with a write-only secret"

  phone_number = "+33612345678"

  api_key_wo         = "your_smspartner_api_key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) Recipient phone number

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) SMS Partner API key for authentication. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMSPartner API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `sender_name` (String) Sender name or identifier

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
